decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting line launched in 2024 extends the firm's core precast automation offer and is still within its early evaluation period. Industry turnover growth gives the firm slack to carry it while results remain uncertain, although the 2024 withdrawal of four robots shows management will cut products that miss aspirations.

The production analysis software is close to the established offer and cheap to maintain. It supports the firm's integrated lifecycle and digitalization strategy, so there is little shortfall that would trigger problemistic search or a reallocation of resources.
